ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels, with white dominating the lower and medial areas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity (black) band along the trailing edge perimeter; high-intensity (white) field in central and lower-basal regions; heavy black-to-white mottling (stippling) at the transition zones and in the lower-right quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth ratio of ~0.15 relative to horizontal fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; amplitude of peaks and valleys is most pronounced on the left lobe with several deep indentations; right lobe shows more consistent, smaller sawtooth-style serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes exhibit an upward-outward convex sweep on the lower boundary and a complex irregular-concave curve along the trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular ring-shaped clusters (white outlines on black) and dark circular spots (black on white) concentrated in the lower-central and right-lateral lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple discrete black linear marks with varying orientations (vertical and diagonal) distributed primarily across the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense clusters of high-relief, calcified white and tan structures (barnacles) localized on both the left and right distal tips; significant irregular notch on the upper margin of the left lobe suggesting previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white ring-shaped scarring (likely lamprey or previous barnacle attachment sites) forming a dense field in the lower right region.
